uslaw-usc-t2-s141b:
Section 141b of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with the goods of the Library of Congress and with order in its halls. It sits in Chapter 5, on the Library of Congress. The Librarian of Congress is to set the marks and rules for the safety of the Library's sets and goods. Those rules also cover the charge of the Library and the keep of good order and fair conduct in its rooms.

A second clause deals with the care of the systems of safety. It names the Chief of the Capitol Police and the Librarian of Congress as the men in charge of those systems. Their charge rests on the powers set by the act that made the section, and on the laws the text names. The part of the text shown here is cut off at the start of that clause.
